Description

Company Overview  
PartnerOne is a long-term software investment group that acquires, operates, and scales successful enterprise technology companies worldwide. With over 30 years of experience, PartnerOne owns and manages a portfolio of high-growth software businesses that serve more than 2,000 leading corporations and government organizations globally. Our focus on operational excellence, sustainable growth, and continuous improvement creates a high-performance environment where accountability, ownership, and collaboration drive success.  
 Position Summary  
We are seeking a highly skilled CRM Software Engineer to support the development, customization, automation, and integration of enterprise CRM platforms, with a primary focus on Zoho CRM and the Zoho One ecosystem.  
This role is responsible for translating approved business requirements and CRM architecture designs into working solutions through configuration, scripting, coding, automation, integrations, and system enhancements. The CRM Software Engineer will work closely with the Corporate CRM Architect, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders to build and maintain scalable CRM solutions that support multiple companies operating within a shared CRM framework.  
The ideal candidate has experience working across multiple CRM platforms including Salesforce, Sage, Quickbooks, HubSpot, and Zoho CRM, with strong software development and systems integration expertise.  
 
Key Responsibilities 
 
CRM Development & Configuration 
• Configure and customize Zoho CRM modules, layouts, forms, fields, profiles, roles, and permissions. 
• Develop and maintain custom functionality within Zoho CRM and related Zoho applications. 
• Implement business workflows, blueprints, automation, approval processes, and notifications. 
• Create custom reports, dashboards, KPIs, and analytics solutions. 
• Configure CRM environments based on established solution designs and implementation specifications. 
 
Software Development & Scripting 
• Develop custom solutions using: 
• Zoho Deluge 
• JavaScript 
• REST APIs 
• Webhooks 
• SDKs 
• Custom Functions 
• Serverless integrations 
• Write, test, deploy, and support CRM scripts and automation. 
• Create reusable components and development standards for multiple company implementations. 
• Troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance existing CRM functionality. 
 
Integrations 
• Develop and maintain integrations between Zoho CRM and external systems including: 
• ERP platforms 
• Financial applications 
• Support platforms 
• Marketing automation systems 
• eCommerce solutions 
• Third-party APIs 
• Build API connections and middleware solutions. 
• Support data synchronization and workflow automation across platforms. 
 
Data Migration & Conversion Support 
• Assist with data migration projects from: 
• Salesforce 
• NetSuite CRM 
• Microsoft Dynamics 
• HubSpot 
• Legacy CRM platforms 
• Perform data mapping, transformation, validation, and migration support. 
• Develop import and validation scripts to improve migration efficiency and data quality. 
 
System Maintenance & Support 
• Troubleshoot CRM issues and provide technical support. 
• Monitor system performance and proactively address technical issues. 
• Participate in testing, deployment, and release management activities. 
• Maintain development, test, and production environments. 
• Support CRM upgrades and new feature deployments. 

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
• 4+ years of experience in CRM development, software engineering, or business systems development. 
• Hands-on experience configuring, customizing, and developing within enterprise CRM platforms, preferably Zoho CRM. 
• Experience with CRM platforms such as Zoho CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot, Sage Intacct, NetSuite CRM, or QuickBooks. 
• Strong experience developing and supporting REST API integrations and third-party system integrations. 
• Proficiency in Zoho Deluge scripting and workflow automation. 
• Strong knowledge of JavaScript, SQL, JSON, and XML. 
• Experience with CRM customization, workflow design, business process automation, and data migration. 
• Experience implementing, enhancing, or migrating CRM solutions. 
• Knowledge of integration architecture, data mapping, and system troubleshooting. 
• Experience with Zoho One ecosystem, including Zoho Flow, Zoho Creator, Zoho Analytics, and Zoho Desk, preferred. 
• Familiarity with Salesforce administration or development is a plus. 
• Experience using Git or other source control platforms. 
• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills with the ability to identify and resolve complex technical issues. 
• Detail-oriented with excellent documentation and organizational skills. 
• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations. 
• Strong time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
• Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with CRM, automation, and software development best practices.

1ea4a162bb057234.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Paid Media & Tracking Assistant to support our digital advertising, analytics, and tracking efforts across multiple paid media platforms. The ideal candidate has practical experience setting up, maintaining, and troubleshooting advertising pixels, events, conversion tracking, and analytics systems, with a strong understanding of how paid traffic is measured and optimized.
You will work closely with the marketing team to ensure that campaigns are properly tracked, conversions are accurately recorded, and our tracking infrastructure provides reliable data for reporting and optimization. This role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys working directly with ad platforms, analytics tools, event tracking, and campaign data rather than focusing solely on strategy.
Key Responsibilities

• 
Set up, manage, and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

• 
Support paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

• 
Define and maintain a clear event tracking structure, including event names, parameters, properties, and conversion definitions.

• 
Implement and validate pixels, events, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and other tracking solutions across websites and campaigns.

• 
Work with the tracking stack, including PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Events Manager, Brevo, and Microsoft Clarity.

• 
Monitor tracking performance and investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, analytics tools, and website data.

• 
Debug tracking issues and identify why an event or conversion is not firing correctly, rather than only setting up campaigns.

• 
Test and validate events across different platforms to ensure that data is being captured accurately and consistently.

• 
Ensure that key events and conversions are properly defined, recorded, and attributed across the relevant platforms.

• 
Assist with campaign setup, audience tracking, retargeting, and conversion measurement.

• 
Analyze campaign and tracking data to identify potential issues and opportunities for improvement.

• 
Work with websites, landing pages, and analytics tools to ensure proper data collection and attribution.

• 
Help maintain organized tracking documentation and ensure that event naming and tracking structures remain consistent.

• 
Stay up to date with changes to advertising platforms, tracking technologies, attribution, and privacy requirements.

• 
Support testing and troubleshooting of new tracking setups before campaigns go live.

Preferred Experience

• 
Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

• 
Experience with TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

• 
Practical experience with PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Microsoft Clarity, and Brevo.

• 
Strong understanding of event tracking concepts, including event names, parameters, properties, conversion definitions, and attribution.

• 
Experience troubleshooting tracking issues and identifying why events or conversions may not be firing, recording, or attributing correctly.

• 
Familiarity with server-side tracking / Conversions API is a strong plus.

• 
Experience with newer or emerging advertising platforms, including ChatGPT Ads, would be a significant advantage.

• 
Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, dashboards, and campaign performance reports.

• 
Strong attention to detail and a hands-on, problem-solving mindset.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for someone who is practical, detail-oriented, and technically curious. You should be comfortable getting into the actual ad platforms and tracking tools, testing events yourself, investigating discrepancies, and figuring out why something is not working as expected.
The ideal candidate should be able to go beyond simply setting up campaigns or implementing pixels. They should understand how the entire tracking flow works, from defining an event and its parameters to ensuring that it fires correctly, is captured by the relevant analytics tools, and is ultimately reflected as a meaningful conversion.
You do not need to be an advanced developer, but you should be confident working with tracking tools, advertising platforms, basic website elements, and analytics systems. Experience working across multiple paid media channels and the ability to quickly learn and troubleshoot new platforms are highly valued.

About the job:

Data Analyst - Autonomous Vehicle (AV) Operations & Infrastructure

Role: Data Analyst AV Support Data Infrastructure & Analytics

Experience: 46 Years

Location: Remote / Flexible

Industry: Global Tech & Mobility Leader

About the Team & Opportunity

Our team owns the end-to-end data foundation driving autonomous vehicle (AV) support operations for one of the world's leading mobility platforms. Every operational metric, real-time rider contact, automated data-quality check, and pre-launch feature instrumentation flows through the systems we architect.

We sit directly at the intersection of AV Program Teams, Operational Analytics, and Core Data Engineering to turn complex operational data into actionable, trustworthy insights.

What Youll Do

Redefine the Core Data Layer: Transform organically grown data environments into a deliberate, clean 'gold layer.' Consolidate overlapping tables, optimize upstream join logic, and establish unified canonical datasets.Deliver Business Analytics & Insights: Partner with AV program leadership to scope ambiguous business challenges, define metrics, build dashboards, and answer high-impact operational questions.Guide Instrumentation for New AV Products: Review Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) across launch lifecycles to ensure proper event logging and telemetry are live before new features ship.Maintain & Govern Data Infrastructure: Monitor daily pipelines for freshness, accuracy, and volume. Build governance frameworks around SLAs, change-management workflows, and automated incident alerting.Scale Real-Time Analytics: Expand streaming feeds (Kafka/Flink/Pinot) to lower latency and power real-time operational notifications as incidents develop.

What Youll Need

46 years in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or Data Engineering with a focus on dataset and pipeline ownership (not just query consumption).Advanced SQL & Distributed Computing: Hands-on experience building production transformations in Spark SQL and Hive, authoring canonical patterns that other engineers build on.Customer Support Data Expertise: Hands-on familiarity with support operations metrics (contacts, tickets, handle time, CSAT) and the nuances of handling messy, multi-grained data.Strong Stakeholder Communication: Proven ability to scope vague business requests, push back when framing is off, and present clear takeaways to non-technical partners.AI Tool Integration: Practical experience using AI/agentic coding platforms to accelerate pipeline, analysis, and dashboard development with high validation rigor.

Preferred Qualifications

AV / Autonomous Systems Interest: Understanding of or genuine curiosity about how autonomous trip operations and support models work.Semantic & Metric Layers: Experience with dbt, LookML, or proprietary metric management systems.Streaming & Real-Time Analytics: Familiarity with Kafka, Flink, Pinot, or real-time event processing.Orchestration & Observability: Hands-on experience with Airflow and data observability tools.Dashboarding & Apps: Proficiency with Tableau, Streamlit, Retool, or custom internal tool suites.

Anam Chaudhry

1e7a80b3d6736fc9.description: # Senior Software Engineer **Remote | Flexible Hours | Contract** We’re looking for **senior software engineers** to contribute to an innovative project focused on training and evaluating next-generation AI systems. You’ll use your real-world software engineering expertise to build challenging environments that test AI models on complex engineering tasks — including **debugging, feature development, refactoring, and performance optimization**. No prior AI experience is required. **Your software engineering expertise is what matters.** ### What You'll Do * Design and build **reproducible Reinforcement Learning (RL) environments** for software engineering tasks. * Create realistic coding challenges involving bug fixes, new features, refactoring, and optimization. * Develop **golden/reference solutions** that define correct outcomes. * Work with codebases written in **Python, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript**. * Diagnose complex bugs and performance bottlenecks. * Implement scalable, maintainable software solutions. * Refactor legacy code and improve system reliability and efficiency. * Document technical reasoning, debugging approaches, and solution decisions. * Review and validate other engineers’ technical contributions. ### What We're Looking For * **5+ years of professional software engineering experience** or equivalent depth of experience. * Strong expertise in at least one of: **Python, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript**. * Strong fundamentals in **algorithms, data structures, system design, and software engineering**. * Experience debugging complex production or large-scale codebases. * Ability to identify root causes and develop robust solutions. * Experience with refactoring, optimization, or modernization of existing systems. * Ability to independently take a technical problem from **understanding → implementation → validation**. * Strong written communication and technical documentation skills. * Curiosity about AI, LLMs, or how AI systems learn is a plus — **AI experience is not required**. ### Why Join? * Work on projects at the intersection of **software engineering and advanced AI**. * Apply your existing engineering expertise to help improve next-generation AI systems. * Solve challenging problems rather than performing repetitive annotation work. * Flexible, remote engagement. * Collaborate with experienced engineers and AI teams. ### Ideal Background This role is particularly suited for engineers who have worked on: **Backend / Infrastructure • Developer Tools • Distributed Systems • Open Source • Cloud Platforms • Performance Engineering • Large Codebases • Systems Programming • Full-Stack Engineering** **If you enjoy solving difficult engineering problems and want to apply your expertise to the development of advanced AI systems, we'd love to hear from you.**

1ee3091227625304.description: Company DescriptionAbstrabit is a Private AI engineering company building AI-powered products and solutions for businesses. We work across the AI stack from deploying and evaluating private and open-weight models to building production applications, agents, workflows, and integrations on top of them. Our engineering work is organized across two closely connected layers: the AI layer, focused on models, inference, evaluation, and AI infrastructure; and the application layer, focused on building reliable, scalable software products that use those AI capabilities. The Context AI models are only one part of a production AI system. They still need applications around them APIs, workflows, user interfaces, authentication, databases, integrations, monitoring, and reliable production infrastructure. Our Software Engineering team owns this application layer. As we build more AI-powered products, we are looking for engineers who want to become strong software developers while working close to modern AI systems. Job DescriptionAs a Software Engineering Intern, you will work primarily on the application layer of our AI products. You will build frontend and backend features, APIs, integrations, workflows, and other product components that connect with AI models and inference services. You will work with experienced engineers on real production systems using technologies such as TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, databases, APIs, and cloud services. You will also gain exposure to how systems such as LLMs, RAG pipelines, AI agents, and private model inference are integrated into production applications. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will be expected to write code, debug problems, understand the systems you are working on, and gradually take ownership of larger pieces of the product. What You'll Work On Depending on the project, you may work on: Building frontend and backend product features. Designing and consuming REST APIs and internal services. Working with databases, authentication, file storage, and third-party integrations. Connecting applications with AI models, inference APIs, RAG systems, and AI agents. Debugging application issues across frontend, backend, and integrations. Writing tests and improving the reliability of existing features. Deploying and maintaining applications using cloud platforms and modern deployment tools. Reviewing your work with experienced engineers and improving it based on technical feedback. You will not be restricted to isolated internship exercises. The objective is for you to contribute to software that is actually being built and used. QualificationsWe care more about your engineering fundamentals and ability to learn than the number of frameworks listed on your resume. You should have: Good programming fundamentals and problem-solving ability. Working knowledge of at least one programming language. Basic understanding of web applications, APIs, databases, and Git. Experience building at least one meaningful software project through coursework, a personal project, internship, hackathon, or similar work. Ability to understand existing code and make changes to it. Willingness to investigate problems instead of stopping at the first solution that appears to work. Ability to communicate clearly when you are stuck, disagree with an approach, or need more context. Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, or similar technologies will help, but we do not expect interns to already know our complete technology stack. Using AI as an Engineer We use AI tools as part of our engineering workflow, and you are welcome to use them. We do not evaluate engineers based on how much code they can type from memory. What matters is whether you can understand the code you produce, question incorrect suggestions, test your implementation, debug failures, and explain the decisions you made. AI can help you write code. You are still responsible for the result. Additional InformationWhat This Role Is Not This is not an AI research or model-training role. Your primary responsibility will be software and product engineering at the application layer. You will work close to our AI engineering team and gain visibility into model inference, RAG, agents, and Private AI infrastructure, but your core focus will be building the applications that make those capabilities useful. This is also not an internship where you spend your time only watching tutorials or completing disconnected training assignments. You will learn by working on real engineering problems with support from the team. Why Join Abstrabit You will get the opportunity to build software in an environment where traditional application engineering and modern AI systems meet. You will: Work on real AI-powered products rather than demo projects. Learn how production applications interact with private and open-weight AI models. Work across frontend, backend, APIs .
